Splurge or skip No. 02: the dining table. Solid wood on top, ordinary chairs around it.

Buy the table for the daily four and borrow space when the crowd comes. A solid top takes hot pans and a decade of elbows, then sands back to new. Veneer gets one chip and keeps it.

Save this before the table hunt.
